question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.

WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        calendar_year,
        SUM(total_sales) as city_total
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, calendar_year
),
eligible_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ct1.cust_city
    FROM city_totals ct1
    JOIN city_totals ct2 ON ct1.cust_city = ct2.cust_city
    WHERE ct1.calendar_year = 2019
      AND ct2.calendar_year = 2020
      AND ct2.city_total >= ct1.city_total * 1.2
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust.cust_city,
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND cust.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM eligible_cities)
    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        SUM(prod_sales) as overall_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        overall_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_city ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) as rank
    FROM product_city_totals
),
top_20_percent_products AS (
    SELECT cust_city, prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE rank <= 1
),
eligible_city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        calendar_year,
        city_total
    FROM city_totals
    WHERE cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM eligible_cities)
),
product_sales_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        pcs.cust_city,
        pcs.prod_id,
        pcs.calendar_year,
        pcs.prod_sales,
        eclt.city_total,
        pcs.prod_sales / eclt.city_total as share
    FROM product_city_sales pcs
    JOIN eligible_city_totals eclt ON pcs.cust_city = eclt.cust_city AND pcs.calendar_year = eclt.calendar_year
),
top_product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        psbys.cust_city,
        psbys.prod_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2019 THEN psbys.prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2020 THEN psbys.prod_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2019 THEN psbys.share ELSE 0 END) as share_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2020 THEN psbys.share ELSE 0 END) as share_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2020 THEN psbys.share ELSE 0 END) - 
        MAX(CASE WHEN psbys.calendar_year = 2019 THEN psbys.share ELSE 0 END) as share_diff
    FROM product_sales_by_year psbys
    JOIN top_20_percent_products t20 ON psbys.cust_city = t20.cust_city AND psbys.prod_id = t20.prod_id
    WHERE psbys.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY psbys.cust_city, psbys.prod_id
)
SELECT * FROM top_product_shares ORDER BY share_diff DESC LIMIT 20
